relations.relationship: Develops comparison attentive to differences and interconnections, while considering a wider hemispheric frame.
relations.evidence_note: Own interview answers on printed pp. 237–238, read in public reproduction of the journal text. He recognizes an Atlantic internal dynamic while noting processes beyond the basin. This is a specified methodological proposal, not an affiliation arrow.

relations.relationship: Warns that accounts of negotiated colonial autonomy must confront the costs of settler expansion to Indigenous peoples and enslaved Africans.
relations.evidence_note: Own answer printed pp. 238–239 acknowledges the risk of adopting settlers’ civilizing mythology and insists on the harms of colonization. This contextual contribution is not a claim that he originated settler-colonial theory or that negotiation erases domination.
